notes.title: Red Yet Capers: Math vs Mayhem RELEASE
notes.content:
Exciting news!  For every sale of Red Yet Capers: Math vs Mayhem, 20% of the proceeds will go towards 1 of 2 childrens charities I support - No Kid Hungry, or The Birthday Party Project.   This game is designed for kids, 8 and up, who love math, and a little fun jumping, shooting, and ducking.  I threw in some mini arcade fun as well.  The goal is to reach the top floor.   Play smart.   Kids are our future, so that is why I made this for them.  

You can also make your own separate donation below:
